description.zh-CN: 深灰工作台，判定线金为唯一强调色。精简标签与图标化常用操作，背景预览设置移至编辑底栏，时间轴网格降噪以突出音符。强调色、底色、文字与事件颜色可在设置中调整（默认 #efcd78 / #252527 / #ebe7e0 / #4d6476 / #6e8a9e），底色始终保持深色。
description.en-US: A deep-grey workspace where the judge-line gold is the only accent. Compact labels and icon-first common actions, background preview moved to the editor footer, and a quieter timeline grid so notes stand out. Accent, base, text and event colors can be changed in Settings (defaults #efcd78 / #252527 / #ebe7e0 / #4d6476 / #6e8a9e); the base always stays dark.

license.zh-CN: 界面字体为 Noto Sans SC 子集（© 2014-2021 Adobe，SIL Open Font License 1.1，完整许可见字体内嵌元数据）；图标与样式为本皮肤原创。
license.en-US: The interface font is a Noto Sans SC subset (© 2014-2021 Adobe, SIL Open Font License 1.1; the full license is embedded in the font metadata); icons and styles are original to this skin.

tokens.font-family: font(ui), Arial, RPE, "Microsoft YaHei UI", "PingFang SC", sans-serif
tokens.ink-line-soft: color-mix(in srgb, var(--rpen-ink-base), white calc(5.5% * parameter(borders) / 100))
tokens.ink-line: color-mix(in srgb, var(--rpen-ink-base), white calc(10% * parameter(borders) / 100))
tokens.ink-field-border: color-mix(in srgb, var(--rpen-ink-base), white calc(13% * parameter(borders) / 100))
tokens.ink-card-border: color-mix(in srgb, var(--rpen-ink-base), white calc(19% * parameter(borders) / 100))
tokens.ink-field-hover: color-mix(in srgb, var(--rpen-ink-base), white calc(23% * parameter(borders) / 100))
tokens.ink-accent-label: color-mix(in srgb, color-mix(in srgb, var(--rpen-ink-text), var(--rpen-ink-base) 31%), var(--rpen-ink-accent) 77%)
tokens.ink-accent-muted: color-mix(in srgb, color-mix(in srgb, var(--rpen-ink-text), var(--rpen-ink-base) 72%), var(--rpen-ink-accent) 67%)
tokens.ink-tips: color-mix(in srgb, color-mix(in srgb, var(--rpen-ink-text), var(--rpen-ink-base) 53%), var(--rpen-ink-accent) 24%)
tokens.ink-heading: color-mix(in srgb, color-mix(in srgb, var(--rpen-ink-text), var(--rpen-ink-base) 22%), var(--rpen-ink-accent) 17%)

set.--rpen-ink-base: oklch(from parameter(base) clamp(0.13, l, 0.34) c h)
set.--rpen-ink-text: oklch(from parameter(text) clamp(0.8, l, 1) c h)
set.--rpen-ink-accent: oklch(from parameter(accent) clamp(0.66, l, 0.95) c h)

set.transition: background-color 110ms var(--rpen-motion-easing), color 110ms var(--rpen-motion-easing), border-color 110ms var(--rpen-motion-easing), box-shadow 110ms var(--rpen-motion-easing)

styles.selector: @offset-control,@beat-controls,@rate-control,@toolbar > label:has(#division),@toolbar > label:has(#grid-count),@toolbar label.y-scale-control,@view-controls label:has(#preview-ratio),@view-controls label:has(#camera-x),@view-controls label:has(#view-divisor)

@offset-control input,@beat-controls input,@rate-control select,@toolbar > label:has(#division) input,@toolbar > label:has(#grid-count) input,@toolbar label.y-scale-control input,@view-controls label select,@view-controls label input[type=number]

@offset-control input:focus,@beat-controls input:focus,@rate-control select:focus,@toolbar > label:has(#division) input:focus,@toolbar > label:has(#grid-count) input:focus,@toolbar label.y-scale-control input:focus,@view-controls label select:focus,@view-controls label input[type=number]:focus

set.transition: background-color 110ms ease, color 110ms ease, border-color 110ms ease
